negative_findings.description: For mBank S.A., pobočka zahraničnej banky (SK), sk-language searching using 'výročná správa' + 'pobočka zahraničnej banky' returned only registry and directory pages (finstat, Wikipedia, banky.sk) — no mBank.sk IR or annual-report page surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: No SK-side mBank annual report hub located in this pass; branch entities may report only through the Polish parent (mBank S.A. IR) and registeruz.sk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Branch-form banks are a structural blind spot: they can be materially present in SK retail while publishing nothing SK-specific.

negative_findings.description: OTP Banka Slovensko appears in search results only as a dissolved entity (ceased 1 Oct 2021, absorbed into ČSOB SK).
negative_findings.result_summary: Treat OTP Banka Slovensko as historical-only; its documents live in registeruz/finstat archives, not on a live IR site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents wasting collection budget on a dead actor and explains discontinuities in SK market-share series around 2021.

negative_findings.description: For Prima banka and UniCredit Bank CZ&SK (SK site) only document PDFs surfaced, not the listing pages that link them; hub URLs recorded are inferred entry points, not observed listings.
negative_findings.result_summary: Document-level URLs are solid; hub-level URLs need a crawl pass to confirm.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection needs a stable listing page to detect new filings — non-guessable PDF IDs make document-only knowledge unsustainable.

negative_findings.description: All candidates were derived from search-result metadata; no URL in this slice was fetched and none should be treated as liveness-verified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confidence scores reflect evidence strength from search results only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream verification pass must resolve every URL; 403/timeout should be read as bot-defence, not death.

negative_findings.description: Privatbanka, Fio banka SK branch, J&T Banka SK, Wüstenrot/ČSOB stavebná sporiteľňa and other second-tier SK institutions did not yield IR pages in the queries run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Cell coverage is strong for the seven systemic retail/universal banks, thin below them.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Niche and challenger banks often reveal payments/product shifts earliest.

coverage_gaps.description: Branch-form banks (mBank S.A. pobočka, UniCredit Bank CZ&SK pobočka, Fio, J&T) lack confirmed SK-language disclosure hubs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sub-pass per branch entity: check parent-country IR site, registeruz.sk by IČO, and the SK site's 'povinne zverejňované informácie' page.

coverage_gaps.description: SK subsidiaries mostly publish annually/semi-annually; quarterly and outlook material for Slovakia exists mainly in parent-group IR (Erste, Intesa, KBC, RBI) and their earnings-call transcripts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Register the four parent IR sites as separate quarterly-cadence sources and add transcript sources for Slovakia-segment analyst Q&A.

coverage_gaps.description: ESEF/XHTML machine-readable filings were observed for Tatra banka and 365.bank but not confirmed for the others; most collection would otherwise be PDF parsing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each bank, check whether an ESEF/XHTML package is published alongside the PDF and prefer it for structured extraction.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-specific disclosure (card volumes, instant payments, POS/acquiring) is not separately searched in this pass — it sits inside annual reports and CSR/sustainability reports rather than in dedicated pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a sub-pass with sk terms 'platobné karty', 'okamžité platby', 'akceptácia platobných kariet', 'POS terminály' against the same bank domains.

coverage_gaps.description: Several banks serve documents from hashed or ID-suffixed paths (365.bank /media/{hash}/, primabanka /preview-file/*-NNNN.pdf) that break silently when re-published.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot every harvested PDF locally and record web.archive.org captures; do not rely on stable remote URLs.

brief: Slovakia's systemic retail/universal banks are all privately or foreign-owned and none is listed in Bratislava, so their native SK-language 'finančné ukazovatele / výročné správy / povinne zverejňované informácie' pages are the authoritative first-party disclosure surface — SLSP, Tatra banka, VÚB, ČSOB SK, 365.bank, Prima banka and UniCredit Bank CZ&SK each maintain one, most with a deep PDF archive and some with ESEF/XHTML filings. Cadence is the main limitation: SK entities disclose annually or semi-annually, while quarterly numbers, Slovakia-segment detail and forward outlook come from the listed parents (Erste Group, Intesa Sanpaolo, KBC, RBI), making parent IR an indispensable indirect layer. Three pointer sources close the loop — registeruz.sk (statutory filings by IČO, the only reliable route for foreign-bank branches), NBS CERI (prospectuses and registration documents with unusually rich strategy/risk narrative) and NBS/SBA lists that define the actor map. Weak spots are branch-form banks with no SK-specific reporting, second-tier institutions, and unstable document URLs that require local snapshotting.
